        🔄
        

          
Refresh All Schema Catalogs

          
Synchronize local autocomplete & search catalog cache

        

      


      
      

        

          💡
          Why is this feature useful?
        

        
    
          
  • Cross-DB Autocomplete: Typing db.table or table.col triggers instant completions without manually opening other databases in the sidebar.
    • 
          
  • Global Search (Ctrl+P): Find tables, views, and columns across all server databases in real-time.
    • 
          
  • Zero Foreign Key Lock: Scans only lightweight table & column identifiers without issuing heavy relation scans (KEY_COLUMN_USAGE).
    • 
          
  • Isolated Persistence: Cache is preserved per-session and never lost when switching active sessions.
    •
